description: A JUnit test class for MultiComparisonNode in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.rql.predicates.ast package. It contains unit tests for constructors, equality, adding values, and visitor pattern acceptance.

classes.name: MultiComparisonNodeTest
classes.description: Test suite for the MultiComparisonNode class, validating behavior such as constructor correctness, equality, value addition, and visitor pattern implementation.

methods.name: hashcodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that MultiComparisonNode correctly implements equals and hashCode methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: typeConstructorWithNullAsFilterProperty
methods.description: Tests that constructing a MultiComparisonNode with a null property throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: typeConstructorSuccess
methods.description: Validates successful creation of MultiComparisonNode and its getter methods, as well as adding a value.

methods.name: addNullValues
methods.description: Tests adding multiple null and non-null values to the node's value list.

methods.name: visitorGetsVisited
methods.description: Checks that the node correctly accepts a visitor and that the visitor's visit method is called.
